drupal/core-vendor-hardening.name: drupal/core-vendor-hardening
drupal/core-vendor-hardening.description: Hardens the vendor directory for when it's in the docroot.
Drupal is an open source content management platform powering millions of websites and applications.

_readme: By default Drupal loads the autoloader from ./vendor/autoload.php.
To change the autoloader you can edit ./autoload.php.
This file specifies the packages.drupal.org repository.
